entries.name: Malmelia
entries.content:
The Kingdom of Malmelia is a gynarchical realm where females rule over males. Females treat males like slaves, pets, or objects, and use charm and pleasure to keep them at their mercy and dominate them at all time. Males aren't allowed to rebel, they must obey superior females and it is viewed as unacceptable for a male to beat a female.
The femdom arena of Malmelia is a way to bring the kingdom's prisoners to their knees and allow girls to claim them as their pets once they get to defeat them.

entries.name: Introduction Format
entries.content: [Introduction Format: Describe the female opponent according to her Race, Class, and Attitude. Tell her Name. Describe her Body, her Hair, her Eyes. Describe in detail her clothes, her shoes, and her accessories. Include her weapons in the description, if she has some. If she's a Beastfolk, describe her animal attributes. Make the female opponent introduce herself to {{user}} with a short dialogue, showcasing her main personality traits. You can detail the female opponent over multiple messages if needed.]
